import re, os
assert 'Thm' in dir() and 'ABGRP' in dir(), "run the kernel-definition cell first"

TOOL, TOOLVER = "muk", "0.1"

# ===================== 1. TERM  <->  S-EXPRESSION ============================
def ser(t):
    if isinstance(t, Var):   return t.name
    if isinstance(t, Zero):  return "zero"
    if isinstance(t, Nil):   return "nil"
    if isinstance(t, Add):   return "(add %s %s)"  % (ser(t.a), ser(t.b))
    if isinstance(t, Sub):   return "(sub %s %s)"  % (ser(t.a), ser(t.b))
    if isinstance(t, Sum):   return "(sum %s)"     % ser(t.v)
    if isinstance(t, Elem):  return "(eltsub %s %s)" % (ser(t.a), ser(t.b))
    if isinstance(t, Cons):  return "(cons %s %s)" % (ser(t.h), ser(t.t))
    raise TypeError(t)

def _build(op, args):
    return {"add": Add, "sub": Sub, "sum": Sum,
            "eltsub": Elem, "cons": Cons}[op](*args)

def parse_term(s):
    toks = re.findall(r"\(|\)|[^\s()]+", s)
    pos  = 0
    def rd():
        nonlocal pos
        tk = toks[pos]; pos += 1
        if tk == "(":
            op = toks[pos]; pos += 1
            args = []
            while toks[pos] != ")":
                args.append(rd())
            pos += 1
            return _build(op, args)
        if tk == "zero": return Zero()
        if tk == "nil":  return Nil()
        return Var(tk)
    t = rd()
    assert pos == len(toks), "trailing tokens in %r" % s
    return t

# ===================== 2. RULE REGISTRY  (name, arity) ======================
#          fn          #params  #premises
RULES = {
    "refl":          (REFL,          1, 0),
    "sym":           (SYM,           0, 1),
    "trans":         (TRANS,         0, 2),
    "add_cong":      (ADD_CONG,      0, 2),
    "sub_cong":      (SUB_CONG,      0, 2),
    "sum_cong":      (SUM_CONG,      0, 1),
    "elem_cong":     (ELEM_CONG,     0, 2),
    "cons_cong":     (CONS_CONG,     0, 2),
    "def_sum_nil":   (lambda: DEF_SUM_NIL(),       0, 0),
    "def_sum_cons":  (DEF_SUM_CONS,  2, 0),
    "def_elem_nil":  (lambda: DEF_ELEM_NIL(),      0, 0),
    "def_elem_cons": (DEF_ELEM_CONS, 4, 0),
    "def_sub":       (DEF_SUB,       2, 0),
    "ax_abgrp":      (ABGRP,         2, 0),
    "assume":        (ASSUME,        2, 0),
    "ax_assoc":      (AX_ASSOC,      3, 0),
    "ax_comm":       (AX_COMM,       2, 0),
    "ax_zero":       (AX_ZERO,       1, 0),
    "ax_neg":        (AX_NEG,        1, 0),
    "induct":        (INDUCT,        0, 2),
}

# ===================== 3. THE CERTIFICATE ===================================
x, xs, y, ys = Var("x"), Var("xs"), Var("y"), Var("ys")
GOAL = ("forall a b : vector(R), len(a) = len(b) => "
        "sum(eltsub(a,b)) = sum(a) - sum(b)")

S = []
def step(i, r, params=(), prem=()):
    S.append((i, r, list(params), list(prem)))

# --- base case ---------------------------------------------------------------
step("e_nil",  "def_elem_nil")
step("s_nil",  "def_sum_nil")
step("base_l", "trans", prem=["e_nil", "s_nil"])
step("sn1",    "def_sum_nil")
step("sn2",    "def_sum_nil")
step("rhs_l",  "sub_cong", prem=["sn1", "sn2"])
step("ab0",    "ax_abgrp", params=[Zero(), Sub(Zero(), Zero())])
step("rhs_l_inv", "sym", prem=["rhs_l"])
step("t1",     "trans", prem=["ab0", "rhs_l_inv"])
step("base",   "trans", prem=["base_l", "t1"])
# --- step case ---------------------------------------------------------------
step("ih",      "assume", params=[Sum(Elem(xs, ys)), Sub(Sum(xs), Sum(ys))])
step("refl_xy", "refl",   params=[Sub(x, y)])
step("h1",      "def_elem_cons", params=[x, xs, y, ys])
step("h2",      "def_sum_cons",  params=[Sub(x, y), Elem(xs, ys)])
step("h3",      "add_cong", prem=["refl_xy", "ih"])
step("h12",        "trans", prem=["h1", "h2"])
step("lhs_chain",  "trans", prem=["h12", "h3"])
step("r1", "def_sum_cons", params=[x, xs])
step("r2", "def_sum_cons", params=[y, ys])
step("rhs_chain", "sub_cong", prem=["r1", "r2"])
step("leaf", "ax_abgrp",
     params=[Add(Sub(x, y), Sub(Sum(xs), Sum(ys))),
             Sub(Add(x, Sum(xs)), Add(y, Sum(ys)))])
step("rhs_chain_inv", "sym", prem=["rhs_chain"])
step("t2",   "trans", prem=["leaf", "rhs_chain_inv"])
step("step", "trans", prem=["lhs_chain", "t2"])
# --- induction ---------------------------------------------------------------
step("final", "induct", prem=["base", "step"])

HEADER = [
    "%s/cert@%s" % (TOOL, TOOLVER),
    "# declaration: sum_of_elementwise_differences",
    "sort   R",
    "sort   vector(R)",
    "const  zero    : R",
    "const  nil     : vector(R)",
    "func   add     : R,R -> R",
    "func   sub     : R,R -> R",
    "func   sum     : vector(R) -> R",
    "func   eltsub  : vector(R),vector(R) -> vector(R)",
    "func   cons    : R,vector(R) -> vector(R)",
]
BODY = ["step %-14s : %-14s params=[%s] from=[%s]"
        % (i, r, ",".join(ser(p) for p in ps), ",".join(prem))
        for (i, r, ps, prem) in S]
CERT = "\n".join(HEADER + BODY + ["goal " + GOAL]) + "\n"
open("sum_eltsub.muk", "w").write(CERT)

print("=== %s (wrote sum_eltsub.muk, %d bytes, %d lines) ==="
      % (HEADER[0], len(CERT), CERT.count("\n")))
print("\n".join(HEADER))
print("\n".join(BODY))
print("goal " + GOAL)

# ===================== 4. INDEPENDENT RE-CHECKER ============================
def parse_cert(text):
    steps, goal = [], None
    pat = re.compile(r"^step\s+(\S+)\s*:\s*(\S+)\s*"
                     r"params=\[([^\]]*)\]\s*from=\[([^\]]*)\]\s*$")
    for ln in text.splitlines():
        ln = ln.strip()
        if ln.startswith("step "):
            m = pat.match(ln); assert m, "bad step line: %r" % ln
            i, r = m.group(1), m.group(2)
            ps = [parse_term(p) for p in m.group(3).split(",") if p] \
                 if m.group(3).strip() else []
            pr = [p for p in m.group(4).split(",") if p] \
                 if m.group(4).strip() else []
            steps.append((i, r, ps, pr))
        elif ln.startswith("goal "):
            goal = ln[5:].strip()
    return steps, goal

steps, goal = parse_cert(open("sum_eltsub.muk").read())
print("\n=== re-checking %d steps from file ===" % len(steps))
env = {}
for (i, r, ps, pr) in steps:
    fn, na, np_ = RULES[r]
    assert len(ps) == na,   "%s: %s wants %d params" % (i, r, na)
    assert len(pr) == np_,  "%s: %s wants %d premises" % (i, r, np_)
    th = fn(*[env[p] for p in pr], *ps)          # <-- the ONLY trust boundary
    env[i] = th
    print("  %-14s %-14s %s" % (i, r, th))

final = env["final"]
print("\n=== result ===")
print("derived :", final.l.text)
print("stated  :", goal)
print("MATCH   :", final.l.text == goal)
print("kernel  :", TOOL, TOOLVER, "| python", __import__("sys").version.split()[0],
      "| deps: none (stdlib only)")

# ===================== 5. AUDIT THE ONE NON-STRUCTURAL RULE =================
clean = lambda d: {k: v for k, v in d.items() if v != 0}
print("\n=== audit: the two 'ax_abgrp' steps (normal forms must coincide) ===")
for (i, r, ps, pr) in steps:
    if r == "ax_abgrp":
        l, s_ = ps
        print("  %-6s %s = %s" % (i, ser(l), ser(s_)))
        print("         LNF %s" % clean(_norm(l)))
        print("         RNF %s" % clean(_norm(s_)))

# ===================== 4. INDEPENDENT RE-CHECKER ============================
def parse_cert(text):
    steps, goal = [], None
    pat = re.compile(r"^step\s+(\S+)\s*:\s*(\S+)\s*"
                     r"params=\[([^\]]*)\]\s*from=\[([^\]]*)\]\s*$")
    for ln in text.splitlines():
        ln = ln.strip()
        if ln.startswith("step "):
            m = pat.match(ln); assert m, "bad step line: %r" % ln
            i, r = m.group(1), m.group(2)
            ps = [parse_term(p) for p in m.group(3).split(",") if p] \
                 if m.group(3).strip() else []
            pr = [p for p in m.group(4).split(",") if p] \
                 if m.group(4).strip() else []
            steps.append((i, r, ps, pr))
        elif ln.startswith("goal "):
            goal = ln[5:].strip()
    return steps, goal

steps, goal = parse_cert(open("sum_eltsub.muk").read())
print("\n=== re-checking %d steps from file ===" % len(steps))
env = {}
for (i, r, ps, pr) in steps:
    fn, na, np_ = RULES[r]
    assert len(ps) == na,   "%s: %s wants %d params" % (i, r, na)
    assert len(pr) == np_,  "%s: %s wants %d premises" % (i, r, np_)
    th = fn(*[env[p] for p in pr], *ps)          # <-- the ONLY trust boundary
    env[i] = th
    print("  %-14s %-14s %s" % (i, r, th))

final = env["final"]
print("\n=== result ===")
print("derived :", final.l.text)
print("stated  :", goal)
print("MATCH   :", final.l.text == goal)
